tools.name: place-order
tools.title: Place an order
tools.description: Take a customer's order: the dishes by name and how many of each, and the name and phone to call when it is ready. It saves the order and its lines and takes the dishes out of stock together; if a dish is short, nothing is saved and the answer says how many are left. Use once the customer has said everything they want.

phone.description: A phone number to call when it is ready

dish.description: The dish's name as the menu has it, e.g. Margherita

tools.name: sales-report
tools.title: Sales by dish
tools.description: Units sold and revenue per dish for a period, from the saved sales_by_dish query. Use when the owner asks how sales went, e.g. this week or last month.

to.description: End, exclusive, in the same form

tools.name: notify-kitchen
tools.title: Tell the kitchen about a new order
tools.description: Posts a new order and its dishes to the staff group. Run by a trigger on orders, never by the assistant.

tools.name: tell-customer
tools.title: Tell the customer their order is ready
tools.description: Messages the customer who placed the order. Run by a trigger when an order becomes ready, never by the assistant.
